meta.title: Rule files
meta.description: Settings section that lists and edits DSH's user-global and per-project rule files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.local.md, CLAUDE.local.md). Open Settings, choose Rule manager, then use the Edit button on a global card or on one file row inside a project card to view, create, edit, or delete that rule file; any existing directory can be added to the project list. Saved files are picked up by DSH when the next session starts.
